@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+from __future__ import (absolute_import, division, print_function)
+__metaclass__ = type
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.hardware import aix
+
+
+def test_aix_get_cpu_facts(mocker):
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    processors = '\n'.join('proc%d Available 00-00 Processor' % i for i in range(12))
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, processors + '\nproc12 Defined 00-00 Processor\n', ''),
+        (0, 'type PowerPC_POWER7 Processor type False\n', ''),
+        (0, 'smt_threads 4 SMT threads False\n', ''),
+    ]
+
+    assert aix.AIXHardware(module).get_cpu_facts() == {
+        'processor': ['PowerPC_POWER7'],
+        'processor_count': 1,
+        'processor_cores': 12,
+        'processor_threads_per_core': 4,
+        'processor_vcpus': 48,
+    }
+    assert module.run_command.call_args_list[1].args[0] == '/usr/sbin/lsattr -El proc0 -a type'
+
+
+def test_aix_get_cpu_facts_without_smt_attribute(mocker):
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    module.run_command.side_effect = [
+        (0, 'proc0 Available 00-00 Processor\nproc1 Available 00-01 Processor\n', ''),
+        (0, 'type PowerPC_POWER7 Processor type False\n', ''),
+        (1, '', 'attribute unavailable'),
+    ]
+
+    assert aix.AIXHardware(module).get_cpu_facts() == {
+        'processor': ['PowerPC_POWER7'],
+        'processor_count': 1,
+        'processor_cores': 2,
+        'processor_threads_per_core': 1,
+        'processor_vcpus': 2,
+    }
+
+
+def test_aix_get_cpu_facts_without_available_devices(mocker):
+    module = mocker.Mock()
+    module.run_command.return_value = (0, 'proc0 Defined 00-00 Processor\n', '')
+
+    assert aix.AIXHardware(module).get_cpu_facts() == {
+        'processor': [],
+        'processor_count': 1,
+        'processor_cores': 0,
+        'processor_threads_per_core': 1,
+        'processor_vcpus': 0,
+    }
+    module.run_command.assert_called_once_with('/usr/sbin/lsdev -Cc processor')
